classification: Retrospective, point-in-time-input constrained; exploratory normal-business comparator, not blind holdout
thesis: Diversified enterprise software and cloud recurring demand supports another year of double-digit growth, followed by scale-driven deceleration, modest margin leverage and fading capital productivity.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: Original FY2019 revenue $125843m and EBIT $42959m; FY2018 revenue $110360m and EBIT $35058m.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Revenue grew14.03%; GAAP EBIT margin34.14%. Base FY20 growth13%, initial margin unchanged; no extrapolation of entire Azure growth to total company.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: FY20 management expected double-digit revenue and operating-income growth, stable operating margin, opex growth11–12%, tax17%, rising cloud capital expenditure.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Base FY20 revenue13% and EBIT13%, tax17%; bear10% revenue with margin pressure; bull15% with modest operating leverage. Management guidance is a conditional expectation.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: FY19 Azure revenue grew72%; cloud mix diluted gross margin while scale/efficiency improved Azure margins; commercial commitments supported renewal demand.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Recurring enterprise/software demand supports moderate base growth and durability; competitive/physical cloud investment curbs terminal margins and excess returns. Bull40% EBIT margin is upside judgment, not guidance.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: FY19 R&D16876m and SBC4652m are already operating expenses. Capex cash13925m; finance-lease additions2532m; cash-flow D&A and OTHER11682m is not pure depreciation.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Retain GAAP R&D and recurring SBC expenses; net additional investment includes physical assets, finance-leased additions, acquisitions and noncash operating working-capital needs, but excludes R&D already expensed. Initial sales/capital2.0 base is judgment, not a ratio backed out of an incomplete cashflow line.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: FY19 tax10% distorted by $2.6bn benefit; FY20 forecast tax17%; legacy transition tax16.4bn remains, plus3.5bn intangible-transfer payment.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Model17% first-year ordinary tax, fade toward23% base/bull or25% bear. Deduct19.9bn undiscounted legacy obligations outside normalized operating taxes; conservative to a discounted liability.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: Debt fair value78.9bn; finance-lease liabilities6.574bn; operating-lease liabilities7.703bn and operating lease cost1.707bn.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Deduct fair debt plus finance leases. Operating leases remain operating expenses, with no second lease debt deduction. Future capital funding includes finance-lease investment; debt financing itself is outside FCFF.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: June30 common7643m; July29 cover7635.4094m; June30 nonvested awards147m and unrecognized compensation8.6bn over weighted average3years.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Use aligned June30 claims and reserve every existing award, no forfeitures. Credit only discounted after-tax future service expense of these awards to avoid full dilution plus duplicate future legacy expense. Uniform3year expense pattern is approximation; future new compensation remains expense.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: Cash plus short-term investments133.819bn; separately reported equityinvestments2.649bn.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Reserve2% of revenue as operatingcash, add remaining131.30214bn plus equity investments at carrying value. No extra goodwill asset or capitalized R&D addback.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: Previous-session2019-08-01 US10y CMT1.90% verified in current FRED historical series; original-release archive not verified. ERP and beta not verified.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Base WACC8% fades7.5%, bear9% fades8%, bull7% flat. Illustrative initial base composition is rounded Rf2% (historical anchor1.90%), beta1.15, ERP5.5%, debtweight6%, pretax debt3.5%, tax17% ->8.0% rounded. Other components are scenario judgments, NOT measured2019 market values; the quoted CMT is a contemporary-date historical-series check, not an original-vintage source.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: Terminal growth2.5%; returns on new net investment15% base,8% bear,20% bull.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Sales/capital fades geometrically to ROC/[margin*(1-tax)*(1+g)]. In year10 g/margin/tax equal terminal; reinvestment from year10 to11 grows exactly2.5%. Terminal ROC is a cash-funding return parameter in this uncapitalized-R&D model, not reported or economically adjusted accounting ROIC.

snapshotOverride.name: Microsoft
snapshotOverride.shareBasis: June 30 common 7643m plus full 147m nonvested stock-award reserve; see future-service credit

accounting.sbc: GAAP recurring expense retained. Existing full-award dilution separately charged; future-service overlap explicitly credited.
accounting.researchAndDevelopment: Expensed throughout; no intangible asset or amortization restatement, no duplicate reinvestment charge.
accounting.shares: Period-end common plus147m awards; uniform3year legacy service credit; no assumptions of future buybacks.
accounting.leases: Finance leases financing; operating leases operating.
accounting.taxes: Normalized future operating taxes plus distinct undiscounted legacy tax claim.
accounting.cash: 2% revenue reserve; remainder plus separate equity investments added.

uncertainty: Modern model pretraining may contain later Microsoft history. This is not a genuinely blind historical forecast or out-of-sample strategy.
Single successful surviving company is a comparator, not representative sample; no probabilities or scenario weights calibrated.
WACC components, terminal ROC, margin, growth and capital productivity are analyst judgments with no later return calibration.
Full award reserve, future-service timing/tax deduction and historical grant-price accounting versus future compensation economics are approximations.
June30 balance sheet used at August2 cutoff; July29 lower cover shares disclosed but no unsupported post-balance-sheet cash adjustment.
Fiscal year-end FCFF is discounted in full annual periods from fiscal base despite August2 decision date; a 33-day timing approximation, not exact trade-date valuation.
Deferred/uncertain tax exposures beyond specifically isolated19.9bn are not separately fair-valued; reserve sensitivities must remain visible.
Annual aggregate model cannot separately price granular cloud replacement cohorts, acquisitions, NOLs or contingent legal claims.
diagnosticFlags: No outcome/price inputs opened by valuation worker before freeze.
No pure-D&A inference from D&A-and-other line.
snapshotAdjustmentNotes: Cash excludes a 2% revenue operating reserve; debt uses fair debt plus finance leases; shares include all 147m existing nonvested awards. Future-service overlap is credited in other assets; legacy tax obligations remain separate claims. See accounting notes and immutable freeze.
